role: held-out model-family natural reasoning replication of the adaptive layer-quota contrast
prerequisites: terminal digest-bound nine-seed P2 causal audit
terminal Phi-4-mini adaptive-quota RULER audit regardless of outcome
terminal Qwen3-4B adaptive-quota LongBench-v2 audit regardless of outcome
verified frozen LongBench-v2 dataset, prompt, scorer, Phi model, and Qwen-selected fixed baseline
execution_policy: run all 503 frozen examples under both arms; prerequisite outcomes never select, cancel, truncate, or reorder categories or examples

benchmark.name: LongBench-v2
benchmark.paired_unit: the same frozen example with identical Phi-rendered prompt and exact context/question token ids
benchmark.overflow_policy: retain every input beyond the Phi 131072-token context as an intention-to-evaluate unsupported-context failure scored zero; never truncate
benchmark.secondary_slice_policy: report observed frozen metadata levels with n >= 10 descriptively; no secondary slice is a confirmation gate
benchmark.reporting: report all six capability categories; sub-domain, difficulty, and length slices remain descriptive

scorer_selection.rule: reuse the frozen score-compatible Qwen selection without Phi RULER or LongBench-v2 outcome inspection

cross-family-adaptive-quota+pins.layer_signal: normalized entropy concentration of z-scored current-layer scorer values
cross-family-adaptive-quota+pins.causal_prior: running mean of earlier-layer concentrations only

cache_lifecycle_contract.question_tokens: append identically after context compression without adaptive reallocation
cache_lifecycle_contract.generation_tokens: decode identically under the arm-specific post-prefill cache
per_successful_example_audit: all 32 initial layer allocations in causal order
configured and observed initial total kept tokens
score concentration and controller time per layer
initial hot-resident bytes, peak HBM, and end-to-end latency

statistics.failure_policy: intention-to-evaluate; every allowed operational or unsupported-context failure scores zero and is never dropped or silently retried

failure_reporting.paired_scoring_policy: the paired analysis retains every frozen example and scores every allowed failure zero

claim_boundary: A passing result supports bounded transfer of the initial score-concentration layer-quota heuristic to frozen LongBench-v2 reasoning on one held-out Phi-4-mini checkpoint at equal initial logical KV budget. It does not establish continuous adaptive reallocation, a second full natural-language suite, Phi-specific optimization, contexts beyond 128K, broad model-population generalization, or official DeepSeek-V4 behavior.
